These numbers appear in the printed output of the last code block. Yes. 4. Unacknowledged Data Problems: They accounted for duplicates and sentinel -999. Any other issues? Possibly imbalance in severity, but they mention it. No missing data left. Sample size moderate. No impossible values. So fine.

5. False premise: The premises are correct per contract. They didn't assume something false. So okay.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept.
